description: One call: give a job posting (text or a public link) and the person's resume (plain text, a PDF or DOCX file in base64, or structured JSON). CareerGenius reads the posting, lists the keywords it asks for and which the resume shows, rewords the summary and bullets for this job, keeps ONLY the rewordings that pass its fact check (no added tools, numbers, titles, results or employers), and returns a clean single-column ATS-readable PDF plus a summary of what changed, what was held back and why. "outcome" explains the result in reason codes and plain words, also when nothing changed: lines reworded / kept / held back, posting keywords the resume does not show, and next steps. Counts one call and uses the AI cap. Review before sending. Without a key: one of the conversation's 2 free AI calls (posting_text only; job_url needs a key). Without a key the whole request is limited to 96 KB.

job_url.description: A public job posting link (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday or a page with JobPosting data). Fetched by our job-import engine; private or internal addresses are refused.

on_behalf_of.description: Required. You confirm a person asked for this, and the resume is theirs (or they are authorised to use it).

resume.description: Structured resume. Only what the person really has done: every output is checked against it.

content_base64.description: The file, base64 (at most 1.5 MB decoded with a key; without a key the whole request is limited to 96 KB). PDFs need a text layer (not a scan).

resume_text.description: A pasted plain-text resume. Read by a fixed layout parser (no AI, nothing added); section headings (Summary, Experience, Education, Skills) help.

template.description: classic (serif, centred header) or modern (sans-serif, left-aligned). Default classic.

name: careergenius_tailor_resume_pdf
title: Tailor resume to a job, as a PDF (one call)
